charts.title: HD 101581 c: orbits around HIP 56998
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 56998's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 101581 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 6.20316078755 d

charts.title: HD 101581 c: its transit
charts.description: HD 101581 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (90, 99, 100) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 397362481, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 168 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 285 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 168 min late; 7-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 95 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
